name: Zucchini Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Muffins

items: 2 cups chopped zucchini (get this smoothly pureed before adding anything else)
1 cup chocolate chips (semi-sweet or dark is best)

steps.title: Prep the pan
steps.body: Heat oven to 350°F. Line/Grease muffin tins.

steps.title: Blend the batter
steps.body: In a blender, blend to just combine, being careful not to over-blend: **2 cups chopped zucchini** (get this smoothly pureed before adding anything else), **½ cup creamy peanut butter**, **⅓ cup melted coconut oil**, **½ cup pure maple syrup**, **2 eggs**, **1 Tbsp vanilla extract**, **1½ cups flour**, **2 tsp baking soda**, **1 tsp cinnamon** and **½ tsp kosher salt**.

steps.title: Fold in chocolate
steps.body: Fold in **1 cup chocolate chips** (semi-sweet or dark is best).

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Divide batter evenly into tins, then bake 18-20 minutes, until just set.
